Switch to the Correct Render Engine

Open `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.blend`, set `scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'`, and save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`. Keep `scene.cycles.device == 'CPU'`, `scene.render.resolution_x == 64`, `scene.render.resolution_y == 64`, and `scene.cycles.samples <= 16`. The saved file must still contain a mesh object `Sphere` with `GlassMat` in material slot 0, and `GlassMat` must still use a Principled BSDF whose transmission is greater than `0.9`. The scene must also still contain at least one camera and at least one light.
source: Blender Manual — Render Engines (Cycles \ EEVEE \ Workbench)
